search.query: | tstats dc(host) AS windows_hosts where index=windows host=$host_filter$

single.option: تعداد Host دارای لاگ Windows در بازه انتخابی

search.query: | tstats dc(host) AS sysmon_hosts where index=sysmon host=$host_filter$

single.option: تعداد Host دارای لاگ Sysmon در بازه انتخابی

search.query: | tstats count where index=windows host=$host_filter$ by host | fields host | eval windows_seen=1 | append [| tstats count where index=sysmon host=$host_filter$ by host | fields host | eval sysmon_seen=1] | stats max(windows_seen) AS windows_seen max(sysmon_seen) AS sysmon_seen by host | where windows_seen=1 AND isnull(sysmon_seen) | stats count AS hosts_without_sysmon

single.option: Windows فعال بدون هیچ رویداد Sysmon

search.query: | tstats count where index=windows host=$host_filter$ by host | fields host | eval windows_seen=1 | append [| tstats count where index=sysmon host=$host_filter$ by host | fields host | eval sysmon_seen=1] | stats max(windows_seen) AS windows_seen max(sysmon_seen) AS sysmon_seen by host | stats sum(windows_seen) AS windows_hosts sum(eval(if(sysmon_seen=1,1,0))) AS covered_hosts | eval coverage=round((covered_hosts/windows_hosts)*100,1)."%" | fields coverage

panel.title: Hostهای جدید Windows در ۳۰ روز اخیر

search.query: | tstats min(_time) AS first_seen where index=windows host=$host_filter$ by host | where first_seen>=relative_time(now(),"-30d@d") | eval _time=relative_time(first_seen,"@d") | timechart span=1d dc(host) AS new_windows_hosts
| tstats count where index IN (windows,sysmon) host=$host_filter$ by _time span=30m index | timechart span=30m sum(count) by index

panel.title: بیشترین حجم لاگ Windows به تفکیک Host

search.query: | tstats count AS events where index=windows host=$host_filter$ by host | eventstats sum(events) AS total | eval share_percent=round(events*100/total,2) | sort - events | head 25 | rename host AS Host events AS Events share_percent AS "Share %"

| tstats count AS windows_events max(_time) AS windows_last_seen where index=windows host=$host_filter$ by host | eval windows_seen=1 | append [| tstats count AS sysmon_events max(_time) AS sysmon_last_seen where index=sysmon host=$host_filter$ by host | eval sysmon_seen=1] | stats max(windows_seen) AS windows_seen max(sysmon_seen) AS sysmon_seen max(windows_events) AS windows_events max(windows_last_seen) AS windows_last_seen max(sysmon_last_seen) AS sysmon_last_seen by host | where windows_seen=1 AND isnull(sysmon_seen) | convert ctime(windows_last_seen) | sort - windows_events | rename host AS Host windows_events AS Windows_Events windows_last_seen AS Windows_Last_Seen

panel.title: پوشش Channelهای Windows برای هر Host

search.query: index=windows host=* | eval normalized_channel=coalesce(Channel,channel,source) | eval Security=if(match(normalized_channel,"(?i)security"),1,0), System=if(match(normalized_channel,"(?i)system"),1,0), Application=if(match(normalized_channel,"(?i)application"),1,0), PowerShell=if(match(normalized_channel,"(?i)powershell"),1,0)```, Defender=if(match(normalized_channel,"(?i)defender"),1,0)``` | stats max(Security) AS Security max(System) AS System max(Application) AS Application max(PowerShell) AS PowerShell ```max(Defender) AS Defender``` max(_time) AS last_seen by host | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort host

panel.title: تأخیر دریافت لاگ به تفکیک Host

search.query: index IN (windows,sysmon) host=$host_filter$ | eval delay_sec=_indextime-_time | stats count AS events avg(delay_sec) AS avg_delay_sec perc95(delay_sec) AS p95_delay_sec max(delay_sec) AS max_delay_sec by host index | eval avg_delay_sec=round(avg_delay_sec,1), p95_delay_sec=round(p95_delay_sec,1) | sort - p95_delay_sec | head 30
| tstats count AS events dc(host) AS hosts max(_time) AS last_seen where index IN (windows,sysmon) host=$host_filter$ by index sourcetype | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort index - events
